text: Human Resource Management (HRM) is an applied major based on economics and management, integrating multiple disciplines such as psychology, sociology, and law. This major focuses on the management of "people" in organizations, studying how to optimize the allocation of human resources and enhance organizational efficiency through systems such as recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and salary design. As one of the core functions of an enterprise, human resource management plays a crucial role in strategic planning, cultural construction, and coordination of employee relations. Currently, it has transformed from traditional administrative support to the role of a strategic partner.
